raw_text: Satellite imagery analysis thread: The 'Chinese base in Ladakh' image is definitively fake. I ran it through multiple GAN detection models and all flagged it. Key findings: (1) repeating texture tiles in the terrain, (2) shadow angles at ~35 degrees when sun position at the claimed time would produce ~52 degree shadows, (3) no temporal consistency with any prior or subsequent imagery of the area.
clean_text: GAN detection analysis of Chinese base imagery confirms fabrication. Repeating texture tiles, incorrect shadow angles for claimed acquisition time, and no temporal consistency with existing imagery.
